question: Which additional divine exemplar is invoked in connection with Ayodhyā in this sequence?
premises: Śrī Rāma is named alongside the previous exemplar.
Ayodhyā is specified as the location.
inference: Śrī Rāma in Ayodhyā is invoked as another exemplar in this teaching.
uncertainties: The predicate is elliptical and continues the sense from the preceding verses.
plain_english: And Śrī Rāma, O great Goddess, O fair-faced one, in Ayodhyā.
